map.An equation is a rule for computing the: An equation is a rule for finding the dependent variable from the independent one. Test a rule on every row of the table. One lucky row proves nothing.
Now the main line. Hours in, liters out. Find its rule. Then we know how thirsty this dome is.
Complete the table, then write the rule. Every row is a witness.

map.A hatch under the irrigation deck. Insid: A hatch under the irrigation deck. Inside is the dome's first climate controller. It is older than the glass.
map.Found our villain. No mastermind — just: Found our villain. No mastermind. Just a rusty controller. Look at the wiring.
map.It's been reading temperature as the INP: It reads temperature as the INPUT. It reads fan time as the OUTPUT. It wired cause and effect the wrong way.
map.Confirmed. It swapped the independent an: Confirmed. It swapped the independent and dependent variables. For years the dome has told the thermometer what to do and obeyed the fans. So sad. Almost poetic.
map.Final quest chain: reseed the wilted row: Last quest: reseed the wilted rows while we rewire. The seed drone drops 9 pods every minute it flies. The rule: d = 9t.
